contract: A visitor opening /agentic-design/landing/ gets the landing page frame (skip link, Pulse header, main with the final h1 and h2#plans, footer with the demo line and the signup app's legal links) in pulse dark or light following the system preference, with ?brand=/?mode= overriding it.

loading.reason: no request is made after the bundle runs; all content is typed constants inside it, so there is nothing to wait for

empty.reason: the frame's copy is typed constants in apps/landing/src/content/, and vue-tsc fails the build if one is missing; the page cannot render without its text

error.reason: no request, no form, no input; the only links go to static pages of the signup app on the same origin

partial.reason: there is one bundled source and nothing arrives in parts

success.evidence: e2e tests/e2e/landing/smoke.spec.ts › frame renders, › title and description, › legal links open the signup app's placeholders

permission.reason: no accounts and no gated content; every visitor gets the same page

dark (default).evidence: e2e smoke.spec.ts › theme follows the system unless the query sets it; unit useTheme.test.ts › resolveTheme gives pulse dark with no query and no light preference, › falls back to dark when window.matchMedia is undefined

light (system).evidence: e2e smoke.spec.ts › theme follows the system unless the query sets it (on load and on a live preference change); unit useTheme.test.ts › follows a change of the system preference when there is no valid ?mode=

query override.evidence: e2e smoke.spec.ts › theme follows the system unless the query sets it (?mode=dark under a light preference); unit useTheme.test.ts › lets a valid ?mode= win over the preference, › ignores a change of the system preference when ?mode= is set

invalid query.evidence: e2e smoke.spec.ts › theme follows the system unless the query sets it (?brand=nope&mode=nope); unit useTheme.test.ts › ignores an unknown brand and an unknown mode one by one

skip link focused.evidence: e2e smoke.spec.ts › skip link moves focus to main (visible inside the viewport, Enter focuses #main, next Tab reaches Membership terms), › focused skip link does not cover the wordmark at 375 and 1280 px (the link sits in the flow and pushes the header down; checked locally on pulse dark and light screenshots after Tab and after Tab+Enter at 375 and 1280: accent fill with padding and focus outline, then the outline around main). pnpm shots cannot press a key in a route state, so these screenshots are not in shots/after

accessibility.evidence: axe (wcag2a/2aa/21a/21aa/22aa) clean on ./?brand=pulse&mode=dark and ./?brand=pulse&mode=light at 1280 and 375 px (e2e › axe in pulse/dark, › axe in pulse/light); landmarks banner, main, contentinfo and one h1 then h2 (› frame renders); keyboard path: first Tab focuses the visible skip link, Enter moves focus to main, Tab order skip link → Membership terms → Privacy notice with nothing in between (› skip link moves focus to main, › frame tab order); no announcements needed (nothing changes without a user action except the visual theme); footer links underlined and min-h-12; nothing stored (› nothing is stored)

responsive.evidence: no sideways scroll at 320 and 375 px (e2e › no sideways scroll at 320 and 375 px); one column with padding 4 at 375 px and max-w-page with padding 8 from md at 1280 px checked on local screenshots; main is flex-1 so the footer sits at the bottom of a tall window
